title: Personality clash with Alberta Hunter's pianist
summary: Hall describes the clash that ended his Alberta Hunter engagement.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, what about the situation with Alberta Hunter?

Well, with Alberta Hunter we got into a personality clash with the pianist, and my expertise was a little too much for him to take, with his master's degree, and my common statement is that I have a Ph.D. in the street, you know, and he couldn't buy that.

And all the well wishers came to me because they didn't know him, and I introduced him to everybody. Everybody I spoke to, I introduced him, but we were -- it wasn't on a leader basis relationship. I just thought it was two people. We'd play like two people. But --
Well, that's the way it went down in,
you know, the reviews and all the commentary about the engagement, you know.
Right, whereas I was playing for her. I let him play whatever I liked what he did. I never criticized what he did, not that I necessarily liked it.
